source_supported_principle_paraphrase: Local control, supervisory coordination and plant-level functions should have explicit allocation/interfaces.
project_consequence: Freeze owner layering and typed seams.

source_supported_principle_paraphrase: Protection/control separation and independent manual paths are system-level features.
project_consequence: Freeze protection priority and manual takeover invariants.

source_supported_principle_paraphrase: Testing cannot exhaustively prove practical software correct.
project_consequence: Combine tests with requirements review, hazard catalog and configuration management.

source_supported_principle_paraphrase: Requirements inspections and system-level hazard analysis should address software contribution to hazards.
project_consequence: Create Digital I&C hazard catalog and review support requirements as requirements artifacts.

source_supported_principle_paraphrase: Changes and related artifacts must be controlled and kept consistent.
project_consequence: Freeze versions/schemas/dependencies; docs/manual/release package must match.

source_supported_principle_paraphrase: Separately developed software with same requirements may have correlated failures.
project_consequence: Forbid automatic independence claims for duplicated/design-diverse logic.

source_supported_principle_paraphrase: True functional diversity requires different component-level requirements/principles.
Digital failure modes should be included in safety reasoning; probability estimates carry major uncertainty.
project_consequence: Use deterministic hazard/coverage evidence; no invented software reliability percentages.

source_supported_principle_paraphrase: Data overload, keyhole effect, mode error, workload imbalance and clumsy automation recur in safety-critical systems.
project_consequence: Permanent HMI checklist and representative task evaluation.

source_supported_principle_paraphrase: Human functions should be explicitly designed rather than left as automation leftovers.
Changes to operator-visible information or control response should be empirically evaluated with representative tasks/dynamics.
project_consequence: Use compact operator task suite in release-candidate acceptance.

source_supported_principle_paraphrase: Verification effort should be commensurate with significance and complexity.
project_consequence: Dependency matrix for .NET/Avalonia/test stack; verify supported combination rather than attempting vendor internals qualification.

source_supported_principle_paraphrase: Correctness includes timing; critical analysis considers worst-case delays and predictable execution.
project_consequence: Treat logical-step timing as contract and measure worst-observed desktop responsiveness.

source_supported_principle_paraphrase: Lost, late, misdirected and rollback-inconsistent messages are characteristic distributed failure modes.
project_consequence: Use as post-M11 fault backlog; preserve replay/history consistency now.

source_supported_principle_paraphrase: Shared data must remain valid and consistent to multiple consumers.
project_consequence: Preserve immutable committed snapshot handoff and single-owner runtime.
